corpus.note: Synthetic, fictitious Spanish corpus for MAZMI 2.0 retrieval comparisons (chunking, lexical mode, per-document diversity). Written for this benchmark; not company data and not a model-accuracy benchmark. Gold evidence phrases are literal substrings of the documents.

limitations: Small synthetic corpus written for this benchmark; not representative of a large or real document base.
Retrieval metrics only: they do not measure answer correctness or abstention.
Single run on one machine; latencies are indicative, not a throughput claim.
